newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Matos slams Comptroller investigation.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Matos slams Comptroller investigation.

text.p: Venezuela's Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar slammed Comptroller General Eduardo Roche Lander Wednesday for opening an investigation into government spending adjustments.
"To me it seems an exaggeration in the fight against corruption to attack a government for meeting a commitment to social justice," a visibly angry Matos told a news conference.

Roche Lander said Tuesday he was looking into a leading legislator's accusation that government ministers had changed their spending allocations without having the necessary resources to back them up.
Matos said changes to budgeted spending had resulted from a new pay deal with public sector employees.
"One has to ask oneself if in the fight against corruption one has to oppose legitimate demands like those made by workers," he said.
Matos added that the extra spending resulting from the 70 percent pay hike would be met through higher than expected oil revenues.
